cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: The planner turns real audio-production requests into ordered, safe, tool-ready workflows for voice creators and small media teams.

test_prompts.prompt: Create a production plan for a 30-second community-radio announcement about safe water in [TARGET COUNTRY OR REGION]. Return the audience, a concise voiceover script, recording guidance, and an ordered post-production plan. State assumptions and avoid inventing local facts.

A creator has one interview recording, one music bed, and a 45-second intro. Produce an ordered, tool-ready plan to clean the speech, remove long silences without damaging words, duck the music under speech, normalize the finished mix, and export a shareable podcast file. State what must be confirmed before execution.
